A Story of Food

It began as a supper club in her home.

Before Kinoya had a counter, it had a dining table. Chef Neha Mishra's home supper club, A Story of Food, sold out night after night and welcomed more than 7,000 guests — the cooking that would make her Dubai's “Ramen Queen”.

In 2021 the supper club became a restaurant at The Onyx Tower 2 in The Greens. In 2023 it crossed the world to open inside Harrods, London. The room stayed the same idea throughout: an izakaya's warmth, a ramen counter's focus, and nothing on the plate that doesn't earn its place.

The room

Wood, paper screens,
and a counter that glows.

A traditional izakaya room — warm wood, hanging lanterns, shoji screens — built around an open ramen counter where every bowl is finished in front of you.
